gloss: fulfillment; execution; performance (of a duty or contract)

definitions.explanation: Carrying out or completing what has been promised, agreed upon, or required by duty. Most commonly used for contracts, obligations, and official commitments.

examples.japanese: {契約|けいやく}を{履行|りこう}する。
{約束|やくそく}の{履行|りこう}を{求|もと}められた。
examples.english: I was asked to carry out my promise.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{国際|こくさい}{条約|じょうやく}の{履行|りこう}に{向|む}けて{具体的|ぐたいてき}な{措置|そち}を{講|こう}じた。
examples.english: The government took concrete measures toward fulfilling the international treaty.

notes:
USAGE:
{履行|りこう} is a formal, written word primarily used in legal, business, and political contexts. It refers specifically to carrying out obligations, contracts, or duties.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {契約|けいやく}を{履行|りこう}する (to fulfill a contract)
- {義務|ぎむ}を{履行|りこう}する (to perform a duty)
- {条約|じょうやく}の{履行|りこう} (fulfillment of a treaty)
- {債務|さいむ}{履行|りこう} (performance of a debt obligation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{実行|じっこう} (execution) is broader and more general. {履行|りこう} specifically implies fulfilling something one is obligated or committed to do.
